name: VMware · Round 1
domainSummary: A virtual infrastructure capability in which ESXi abstracts physical compute, memory, storage, and devices into managed virtual machines, while vCenter organizes lifecycle, resource pools, placement, snapshots, migration, and shared capacity.
evidenceBoundary: Do not use VMware logos, product UI, literal server racks, nested squares copied from branding, or hardware diagrams. Preserve the abstract virtual-over-physical relationship.

researchSources.title: Broadcom VMware virtual-machine resource guidance
researchSources.use: Official ESXi virtual CPU, memory, topology, and physical-host relationship.

researchSources.title: Broadcom resource-pool guidance
researchSources.use: Official vSphere virtual-machine grouping and shared resource allocation context.
